arguments.text: A general lifting route from an exact witness: let n0,x0,y0,z0 be positive with x0<y0<z0 and4/n0=1/x0+1/y0+1/z0. Put r=4x0-n0>0,b0=n0*x0,d=r*y0-b0>0. Then d*(r*z0-b0)=b0^2. For integer t>=0 set N=n0+4*r*d*t, X=x0+r*d*t,B=N*X,Y=(B+d)/r,Z=(B+B^2/d)/r. B-b0 is a multiple of r*d in Z[t], so Y,Z have integer coefficients (their constant terms are y0,z0). Factor identity proves4/N=1/X+1/Y+1/Z. X>0; Y-X has positive constant y0-x0 and nonnegative other coefficients, because its linear coefficient is2*d*n0 and its quadratic coefficient positive. Z-Y=(B^2/d-d)/r has positive constant z0-y0 and nonnegative other coefficients. Thus X<Y<Z for every t>=0. This is a written general lemma, with no novelty claim; the next actions check explicit lifted families independently. It propagates already solved inputs, not a descent or covering proof for every n.

proposal.falsifier: A division or coefficient-integrality error invalidates the lift; coverage of all input integers is not supplied by this lemma.
proposal.rationale: Turn particular witnesses into certified infinite arithmetic progressions while retaining the original coverage gap.
